name: LLaVA-OneVision-Qwen2-7B (HF format)
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, textbook LLaVA construction. (1) Vision: SigLIP vision tower (model_type siglip_vision_model), 26 layers, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 384, vision_use_head false, vision_feature_layer -1, vision_feature_select_strategy 'full' (all 26 layers' features, not just the last). This is the canonical 'ViT-L/14 + 2-layer MLP projector' design. (2) LLM: Qwen2-7B (_name_or_path Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct), 28 layers, hidden 3584, 28 heads / 4 KV, head_dim 128, intermediate 18944, vocab 152,128. ARCHITECTURE = dense. VISION TOKENS: each 384x384 tile = (384/14)^2 = 729 patches. LLaVA-OneVision bilinearly pools anyres tiles 2x2 to ~182 tokens each; the base (global) view keeps its own representation, and use_image_newline_parameter true adds a learned newline token per tile row. image_grid_pinpoints enumerates 36 resolutions on a 384/768/1152/1536/1920/2304 grid, and vision_aspect_ratio 'anyres_max_9' caps selection at 9 tiles plus the base view. So a single image costs roughly 9*182 = 1,638 pooled tokens + base, i.e. of order 1.6k-2.4k tokens. DOMINANCE: VISION DOMINATES -- ~2,000 vision tokens vs a ~100-token text prompt. KV CACHE: 28 * 4 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 57,344 B/token. params_b 8.031 = HF API safetensors total (8,030,807,584); vision tower ~0.4B + 2-layer projector is the gap over a 7B text model. Note the HF-format config has no explicit max_position_embeddings for the text tower; 32,768 is inherited from the Qwen2-7B base config.
